title: Planar integrability of an exponential majorant on the standard modular domain
statement: Let ℍ be the upper half-plane, F₀={z∈ℍ : 1≤|z|² and |Re z|≤1/2}, and ν=dx dy, the comap of complex Lebesgue measure along the inclusion ℍ→ℂ. For every real a>0, the real-valued function z↦exp(−a Im z) is ν-integrable on F₀.
lean_statement: ∀ (a : ℝ), 0 < a → MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun z : UpperHalfPlane => Real.exp (-a * z.im)) ModularGroup.fd ((MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure ℂ).comap UpperHalfPlane.coe)
